translations.web: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
translations.bsb: So the people scattered all over the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
translations.kjv: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.
